section_1_result.basis: The authorized local state-machine scope is implemented and all required scoped tests and checks pass.

details: Explicit legal transition validation was added to the existing PddSessionState.
PddSessionHost now validates session identity, handles supported runtime signals, and fails closed on unsupported or illegal signals.
Focused tests cover state transitions, event handling, isolation, safe projection, and authentication-boundary semantics.

section_3_exact_state_vocabulary.name: STOPPED
section_3_exact_state_vocabulary.meaning: The local PDD session has not begun or has been reset before creation.

section_3_exact_state_vocabulary.name: CREATING
section_3_exact_state_vocabulary.meaning: The local session host is creating its per-shop view/session boundary.

section_3_exact_state_vocabulary.name: LOADING
section_3_exact_state_vocabulary.meaning: The local page/runtime fixture or reload is being loaded.

section_3_exact_state_vocabulary.name: LOGIN_REQUIRED
section_3_exact_state_vocabulary.meaning: The local page/runtime emitted an observation that login is required.

section_3_exact_state_vocabulary.name: READY
section_3_exact_state_vocabulary.meaning: The local page/runtime passed its existing readiness signal and the adapter may use its existing local ready gate.

section_3_exact_state_vocabulary.name: DOM_UNSUPPORTED
section_3_exact_state_vocabulary.meaning: The local page/runtime reported that the expected supported surface is unavailable.

section_3_exact_state_vocabulary.name: ERROR
section_3_exact_state_vocabulary.meaning: The local session host failed closed after an exception, illegal transition, or unsupported event.

section_3_exact_state_vocabulary.name: DISPOSED
section_3_exact_state_vocabulary.meaning: The local session view and host have been disposed.

section_4_legal_transition_table.reason: Consume the existing local page-ready observation only.
Fail closed on an unsupported local surface.
Consume the existing local page-ready observation only.
Fail closed on an unsupported local surface.
A fresh local page/runtime readiness observation is the only recovery signal; it does not assert authentication truth.
A specific unsupported-page observation supersedes the earlier login observation.
Re-enter local loading on an explicit reload.
Allow explicit local re-observation after reload.
Allow explicit local recovery attempt without asserting platform recovery.
Dispose local host state; repeated disposal is idempotent.
Repeated signals are idempotent where the explicit table permits them.

behavior: PddSessionState rejects an unknown status and rejects an unlisted transition without mutating the previous state.
PddSessionHost converts an illegal supported event transition to ERROR.
PddSessionHost converts an unknown runtime event to ERROR.
Events with a different session_id are ignored and cannot mutate local state.
Create/load/reload exceptions fail closed to ERROR and preserve the exception for the caller.

details: The existing PddSessionHost owns a PddSessionState per shop/session.
Supported page/runtime events are consumed without adding network or PDD protocol behavior.
The existing status-only projection remains the renderer-facing boundary.
No new IPC channel, UI surface, credential flow, or session persistence was added.
Session identity is checked before event handling.
Existing per-shop Chromium partition and coordinator boundaries are preserved.
Focused desktop isolation tests and the existing multi-shop tests pass.
PlatformAccount existence does not imply authenticated session, authorization, entitlement, seller verification, or send readiness.
SHEEP-082 local identity semantics are unchanged: externalRef remains nullable/unbound, customerUid remains buyer identity only, and the observed mall_cs-side UID remains opaque/unbound.
No PDD seller identity or authorization binding was added.
No credential, Cookie, Token, Authorization header, password, QR material, anti_content, or session secret is read, stored, logged, or projected.
The status view exposes only shop_id, session_id, status, bounded last_error, active_conversation_id, and buyer_id.
No raw ipcRenderer, filesystem, SQLite, or unrestricted system API was added to the renderer boundary.

section_22_targeted_repair_closeout.objective: Repair only the confirmed local LOGIN_REQUIRED recovery gap.
exact_transition_changes: LOGIN_REQUIRED now legally accepts page_ready only after a fresh local page/runtime readiness observation.
Fresh unsupported DOM remains fail-closed as dom_unsupported.
section_22_targeted_repair_closeout.runtime_reobservation_path: The existing mutation observer remains active while LOGIN_REQUIRED is observed; a later DOM change re-runs the existing readiness check, emits page_ready only for a fresh supported DOM, and then permits the local state transition.
